root.label: Tennessee pauses executions for lethal injection investigation

events.label: Tennessee pauses executions for lethal injection investigation

slots.name: prior protocol drugs
slots.sentence: That review led Tennessee to alter its lethal injection protocol, shifting from a procedure involving three different drugs to the current one used in Pike's case, consisting solely of pentobarbital.

slots.name: pause date
slots.sentence: Lee, in 2022, said the pause would allow for an investigation into its lethal injection process after it was determined that corrections officials didn't test the lethal drugs they'd planned to use for that year's execution of Oscar Smith for bacteria.
